recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It fixes stale active guidance without changing the already-correct Money datatype or MoneyQuantity constraint definitions.
issue_request: FHIR-16297 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It requested a lighter Money datatype with value and currency, both 0..1, and a rename of the old Quantity-based Money profile to MoneyQuantity for contexts where Money must be represented as Quantity.
initial_application: Commit f6a1e8b33374575365609b3ab02dbed98b77133a applied the main change in 2018 by adding MoneyQuantity=Quantity, defining the MoneyQuantity rule, adding Money datatype narrative, and updating fhir.ini. Current source/datatypes/money.xml and source/datatypes/quantity.xml already carry those definitions.
additional_context: FHIR-22657 later clarified the same Money versus MoneyQuantity split on the datatypes page and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 944c8172dbcb92f00fd33da54ff49cd9e74bf84c. Current source/datatypes.html now correctly lists MoneyQuantity as a Quantity constraint and Money as a datatype.
reconciliation: Changed source/elementdefinition.html and source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-notes.xml from Money/money.profile.xml.html constrained-datatype examples to MoneyQuantity/moneyquantity.profile.xml.html, including the StructureDefinition example url/name.
source_changes: source/elementdefinition.html: changed the constrained datatype example link and formal-definition links from Money/money.profile.* to MoneyQuantity/moneyquantity.profile.*.
source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-notes.xml: changed the constrained datatype example and JSON url/name from Money to MoneyQuantity.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue clarified that MoneyQuantity, not Money, is the Quantity constraint; it has already been reconciled on the combined branch.
